model_organism.citation: SUMO2 is essential while SUMO3 is dispensable for mouse embryonic development. (PMID: 24891386)
phenotypes: Sumo2-/- embryos exhibit severe developmental delay
Embryonic lethality at approximately embryonic day 10.5 (E10.5)
Sumo3-/- mice are viable with no overt phenotype
Sumo2+/-;Sumo3-/- compound mice are extremely rare at birth and considerably smaller than littermates
SUMO2 is the predominantly expressed SUMO isoform
model_organism.sample_size: 35 litters assessed for Sumo2+/-;Sumo3-/- cross; only 2 Sumo2+/-;Sumo3-/- mice found at birth

model_organism.citation: Small ubiquitin-like modifier 2 (SUMO2) is critical for memory processes in mice. (PMID: 32910521)
phenotypes: Marked impairments in episodic memory
Marked impairments in fear memory
Deficit in maintenance of hippocampal long-term potentiation (LTP)
No constitutive changes in gene expression
No alterations in neuronal morphology
Impairment in dynamic SUMOylation processes associated with synaptic plasticity

model_organism.citation: The requirement of SUMO2/3 for SENP2 mediated extraembryonic and embryonic development. (PMID: 31625212)
phenotypes: Inactivation of Sumo2 gene alleviates placental deficiencies caused by SENP2 loss
Reduction of SUMO2 compensates for hyper-SUMOylation in SENP2-deficient embryos
Alleviation of placental defects leads to proper formation of heart structures including atrioventricular cushion and myocardium
SUMO2 and SUMO3 modifications regulate placentation and organogenesis mediated by SENP2
SUMO2 genetically interacts with SENP2 for development of three major trophoblast layers

model_organism.citation: Genetic and pharmacologic enhancement of SUMO2 conjugation prevents and reverses cognitive impairment and synaptotoxicity in a preclinical model of Alzheimer's disease. (PMID: 40047257)
phenotypes: Genetic overexpression of human SUMO2 prevents LTP impairments in APP transgenic mice
SUMO2 overexpression prevents cognitive deficits in APP transgenic mice without affecting amyloid pathology
Systemic administration of recombinant SUMO2 analogue (SBT02) halts progression of AD-associated deficits
SBT02 restores cognition and synaptic function in late-stage amyloid load
SUMO2/SBT02 mitigate synaptotoxicity in presence of high amyloid loads without altering amyloid processing or clearance

model_organism.citation: Bone marrow stromal cells protect myeloma cells from ferroptosis through GPX4 deSUMOylation. (PMID: 39653239)
phenotypes: SUMO2-KO mice used to validate SENP3-mediated deSUMOylation of GPX4 at lysine 75
CD138+B220- cells from SUMO2-KO mice showed altered GPX4 stability
Loss of SUMO2 disrupts protection of myeloma cells from ferroptosis in the bone marrow niche

model_organism.citation: SUMOylation of Nuclear γ-Actin by SUMO2 supports DNA Damage Repair against Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury. (PMID: 35864967)
phenotypes: SUMO2 silencing decreased levels of nuclear γ-actin and SUMOylation
SUMO2 silencing exacerbated DNA damage in cardiomyocytes
SUMO2 overexpression reduced TUNEL positive cells, 8-OHdG and p-γ-H2ax levels
SUMO2 overexpression promoted nuclear deposition of γ-actin in mouse model of myocardial infarction
Mutated γ-actin (K68R/K284R) lacking SUMOylation sites failed to protect cardiomyocytes against hypoxia-reoxygenation

model_organism.citation: Vagal stimulation ameliorates murine colitis by regulating SUMOylation. (PMID: 39565873)
phenotypes: Deletion of Sumo3 protected against development of colitis and delayed onset of disease
Deletion of Sumo1 halted the progression of colitis
Bone marrow transplants from Sumo1-KO but not Sumo3-KO mice into wild-type mice conferred protection against colitis
Colonic biopsies showed increase in SUMO2 and SUMO3 during active IBD disease
Vagal stimulation inhibited SUMOylation and delayed onset of colitis in Sumo1-KO mice and resulted in milder symptoms in Sumo3-KO mice

model_organism.citation: ZFP451-mediated SUMOylation of SATB2 drives embryonic stem cell differentiation. (PMID: 34244292)
phenotypes: Conditional Satb2 gene inactivation weakens ESC pluripotency
Zfp451 knockout impairs ability of ESCs to silence pluripotency genes
Zfp451 knockout impairs activation of differentiation-associated genes in response to retinoic acid
SUMO2-SATB2 fusion protein rescues impaired differentiation potential in Satb2K→R or Zfp451-/- ESCs
SUMO2 modification of SATB2 by ZFP451 identified as driver of ESC differentiation

model_organism.citation: Splenic SUMO1 controls systemic inflammation in experimental sepsis. (PMID: 37520526)
phenotypes: Global SUMO3 knockout did not significantly affect TNFα production or metabolic acidosis in endotoxemia
Global SUMO1 knockout enhanced TNFα production and metabolic acidosis in endotoxemia
Transfer of SUMO1-null but not wild-type splenocytes into splenectomized wild-type mice exacerbated TNFα production
Endotoxemia induced distinct temporal and substrate specificity for SUMO1 and SUMO2/3 in spleen

model_organism.citation: Aberrant SUMO2/3 modification of RUNX1 upon SENP1 inhibition is linked to the development of diabetic retinopathy in mice. (PMID: 37890757)
phenotypes: Streptozotocin-induced diabetic mice showed elevated levels of SUMO2/3 in retinal tissues
RUNX1 protein was primarily modified by SUMO2/3 in diabetic retinopathy model
SENP1 inhibition of SUMO2/3 modification reduced RUNX1 expression
Overexpression of SENP1 alleviated retinal symptoms and inflammation in diabetic mice
SUMO2/3-dependent activation of RUNX1 promotes proliferation of retinal microvascular endothelial cells

biological.citation: Ferroptosis-induced SUMO2 lactylation counteracts ferroptosis by enhancing ACSL4 degradation in lung adenocarcinoma (PMID: 41057295)
biological.summary: SUMO2-K11 lactylation (SUMO2-K11la) is the most prominently elevated lactylation modification in response to ferroptosis induction in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) cells. SUMO2-K11la impairs the interaction between SUMO2 and ACSL4, facilitating ACSL4 degradation and thereby conferring ferroptosis resistance. A cell-penetrating peptide inhibiting SUMO2-K11la potentiated ferroptosis and sensitized LUAD to cisplatin in xenograft models.

biological.citation: Targeting SUMO2 reverses aberrant epigenetic rewiring driven by SS18::SSX fusion oncoproteins and impairs sarcomagenesis (PMID: 40804185)
biological.summary: CRISPR library screening identified SUMO2 as one of the strongest selective dependencies in synovial sarcoma (SySa) cells both in vitro and in vivo. SUMO2 inhibition with TAK-981 suppressed growth, reversed the SS18::SSX-driven gene expression program, and reduced chromatin occupancy of the fusion protein along with H2AK119 ubiquitination. This identifies SUMO2 as a novel, selective vulnerability in synovial sarcoma.

biological.citation: Rbms1 promotes pulmonary fibrosis by stabilising Sumo2 mRNA to facilitate Smad4-SUMOylation and fibroblast activation (PMID: 40473311)
biological.summary: RBMS1 binds to the Sumo2 3' untranslated region to enhance Sumo2 mRNA stability, increasing SUMO2 protein levels in lung fibroblasts following TGF-β1 stimulation. Elevated SUMO2 facilitates SUMOylation of Smad4 at lysine 158, promoting fibroblast activation and pulmonary fibrosis. Sumo2 knockdown alleviated the Rbms1-driven exacerbation of pulmonary fibrosis in mouse models.

biological.citation: Induced proximity to PML protects TDP-43 from aggregation via SUMO-ubiquitin networks (PMID: 40246979)
biological.summary: SUMO2 modification compartmentalizes TDP-43 in promyelocytic leukemia protein (PML) nuclear bodies and limits TDP-43 aggregation in response to proteotoxic stress. Exploiting this pathway through proximity-induced recruitment of TDP-43 to PML triggers a SUMOylation-ubiquitylation cascade that protects TDP-43 from stress-induced insolubility, mediated by ubiquitylation and the p97 disaggregase. This demonstrates a protective role for SUMO2 in preventing insoluble TDP-43 inclusions relevant to neurodegenerative disease.

biological.citation: DHX9 SUMOylation is required for the suppression of R-loop-associated genome instability (PMID: 39019926)
biological.summary: SUMOylation of RNA helicase DHX9 at lysine 120 is crucial for its function in resolving R-loops and maintaining genome stability. Wild-type DHX9 interacts with R-loop-associated proteins PARP1 and DDX21 via SUMO-interacting motifs, and fusion of SUMO2 to the non-SUMOylatable DHX9 K120R mutant restored these interactions, reduced R-loop accumulation, and alleviated cell survival defects. This demonstrates that SUMO2 mediates protein-protein interactions essential for R-loop homeostasis.

biological.citation: Bone marrow stromal cells protect myeloma cells from ferroptosis through GPX4 deSUMOylation (PMID: 39653239)
biological.summary: SUMO2 is conjugated to GPX4 at lysine 75, and SENP3-mediated de-conjugation of SUMO2 from GPX4 stabilizes the GPX4 protein, thereby consuming ROS and protecting multiple myeloma cells from ferroptosis. This mechanism was validated using SUMO2-KO mice, where loss of SUMO2 abrogated the protective effect of bone marrow stromal cells on myeloma ferroptosis resistance. The study places SUMO2 in a CD40/CD40L-SENP3-GPX4 axis regulating ferroptosis in the tumor microenvironment.

biological.citation: LncRNA INHEG promotes glioma stem cell maintenance and tumorigenicity through regulating rRNA 2'-O-methylation (PMID: 37980347)
biological.summary: SUMO2 E3 ligase TAF15 is induced by lncRNA INHEG to interact with and SUMOylate NOP58, a core component of the snoRNP complex that guides rRNA 2'-O-methylation. This SUMO2-mediated SUMOylation of NOP58 accelerates C/D box snoRNP assembly and enhances rRNA methylation, increasing translation of oncoproteins including EGFR, IGF1R, CDK6, and PDGFRB in glioma stem cells. This identifies SUMO2 as a regulator of ribosome biogenesis and oncogenic translation in glioblastoma.

biological.citation: Sumoylation of methionine adenosyltransferase alpha 1 promotes mitochondrial dysfunction in alcohol-associated liver disease (PMID: 38100286)
biological.summary: SUMO2 specifically SUMOylates MATα1 at lysine 48 (K47 in humans), depleting mitochondrial MATα1 and contributing to mitochondrial dysfunction in alcohol-associated liver disease. Mutation of MATα1 K48 prevented ethanol-induced mitochondrial membrane depolarization, MATα1 depletion, and triglyceride accumulation in primary hepatocytes and mouse models. CRISPR editing of MATα1 K48 in vivo protected mice from ethanol-induced fat accumulation, liver injury, and mitochondrial dysfunction.

biological.citation: SUMOylation-Driven mRNA Circularization Enhances Translation and Promotes Lymphatic Metastasis of Bladder Cancer (PMID: 37991737)
biological.summary: SUMO2 modification at lysine 108 of hnRNPA2B1 is mediated and recognized by DHCR24, fostering TBK1 mRNA circularization and eIF4F initiation complex assembly by enhancing hnRNPA2B1-eIF4G1 interaction. This SUMO2-dependent mechanism elevates TBK1 expression, activates PI3K/Akt signaling, promotes VEGFC secretion, and drives lymphangiogenesis and lymph node metastasis in bladder cancer. DHCR24 silencing significantly impeded bladder cancer lymphangiogenesis in a patient-derived xenograft model.

biological.citation: ASHG 2022 - Maternally Inherited novel SUMO2 variant associated with a complex phenotype (D. Otohinoyi, C. Hicks, R. Zambrano)
biological.summary: A novel maternally inherited heterozygous variant in exon 1 of SUMO2 (c.2T>A: p.Met1?) was identified by whole exome sequencing in a proband and his mother, both presenting with skeletal abnormalities including tibial agenesis, syndactyly, and clubfoot. In silico analysis and ACMG guidelines support a pathogenic classification for this variant. Animal studies showing that SUMO2 knockdown alters expression of CDX2, OCT4, and NANOG and results in embryonic lethality support the developmental importance of SUMO2.
